description: Highly extensible fuzzy finder for files, grep, LSP, and more. Requires ripgrep for live_grep.
author: nvim-telescope
tagline: Highly extensible fuzzy finder over lists

options.label: Layout Strategy
options.description: How the picker window is arranged on screen.

options.label: Preview Width (Horizontal)
options.description: Width of the preview pane in horizontal layout. Use a decimal 0-1 for percentage (e.g., 0.55 = 55%).

options.label: Picker Width
options.description: Total width of the telescope window. Use decimal for percentage or integer for fixed columns.

options.label: Picker Height
options.description: Total height of the telescope window. Use decimal for percentage or integer for fixed rows.

options.label: Sorting Strategy
options.description: How results are sorted in the picker list.

options.label: Selection Strategy
options.description: How the selection cursor behaves when the list updates.

options.label: Scroll Strategy
options.description: What happens when scrolling past the edge of the results list.

options.label: Initial Mode
options.description: Which mode to start in when opening a picker.

options.label: Wrap Results
options.description: Wrap long result lines instead of truncating them.

options.label: Prompt Prefix
options.description: Text shown before the search input.

options.label: Selection Caret
options.description: Text shown next to the currently selected item.

options.label: Entry Prefix
options.description: Text shown before each non-selected item.

options.label: Multi-Select Icon
options.description: Icon shown next to multi-selected items.

options.label: Path Display
options.description: How file paths are displayed in results.

options.label: Window Transparency
options.description: Transparency of the telescope window. 0 = fully opaque, 100 = fully transparent.

options.label: Border Characters
options.description: Characters used for window borders. Array of 8 strings: top, right, bottom, left, top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.

options.label: Color Devicons
options.description: Show colored file type icons (requires nvim-web-devicons plugin).

options.label: Show Results Title
options.description: Show a title in the results window border.

options.label: Enable Preview
options.description: Show a preview of the selected item. Disable to save screen space.

options.label: File Ignore Patterns
options.description: Lua patterns for files/directories to exclude from results. E.g., 'node_modules/', '.git/'.

options.label: Vimgrep Arguments
options.description: Command arguments for live_grep. Default uses ripgrep. Modify only if you know what you're doing.

functions.name: find_files
functions.label: Find Files
functions.whatItDoes: Opens a fuzzy file finder to quickly search and open files in your project.

params.name: cwd
params.description: Directory to search in (defaults to project root)

functions.name: live_grep
functions.label: Search in Files
functions.description: Search file contents with live grep (requires ripgrep)
functions.whatItDoes: Searches the contents of all files in your project. Type and see matching lines instantly. Requires ripgrep (rg) to be installed.

functions.name: buffers
functions.label: Switch Buffer
functions.description: List and switch between open buffers
functions.whatItDoes: Shows all currently open files (buffers) so you can quickly switch between them.

functions.name: help_tags
functions.label: Search Help
functions.whatItDoes: Opens a fuzzy finder for Neovim's built-in help documentation. Great for learning Neovim commands.

functions.name: oldfiles
functions.label: Recent Files
functions.whatItDoes: Shows files you've recently opened in Neovim, so you can quickly reopen them.

functions.name: git_files
functions.label: Git Files
functions.whatItDoes: Shows only files tracked by git in the current repository. Faster than find_files in large projects.

functions.name: git_commits
functions.label: Browse Git Commits
functions.whatItDoes: Shows the git commit history. Select a commit to see its diff and details.

functions.name: lsp_references
functions.label: Find References
functions.description: List references to the symbol under the cursor
functions.whatItDoes: Shows all places in your codebase that reference the symbol your cursor is on. Requires an LSP server.

functions.name: lsp_definitions
functions.label: Go to Definition
functions.description: Go to the definition of the symbol under the cursor
functions.whatItDoes: Jumps to where the symbol under your cursor is defined. Requires an LSP server.

functions.name: diagnostics
functions.label: Show Diagnostics
functions.description: List all diagnostics (errors, warnings) in the workspace
functions.whatItDoes: Shows all errors, warnings, and hints from your LSP servers across the entire project.

functionTemplates.label: Search in Lua Files
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Search text in Lua files only
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Searches file contents filtered to only .lua files. Useful when working on Neovim config.

functionTemplates.label: Find Hidden Files
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Opens the file finder including hidden files (dotfiles like .gitignore, .env, etc.).

exCommands.name: Telescope
exCommands.description: Open a Telescope picker by name. Without arguments, opens the builtin picker list.

params.name: picker
params.description: Picker name to open (e.g. find_files, live_grep, buffers).
